notes.title: First Mediumscale update
notes.notes:
Made it a bit easier to distinguish between the ground/air by doing a DOF.
Also added a new weapon
And changed the gameplay a bit esp on the 4th Level

Looking into other options, currently exploring Unity option, though even though in theory its a lot easier than SQL I can't get the thing working
